answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Compass maker bound atlas seal filed with the chart house flips the bet — each bound atlas is a measured meridian arc plus a guild signature, so a farm must calibrate a hundred real compasses by hand — and the reef lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the marble of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The grove is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
